288:t_1:3.en: ～$$トップレス$$ $$タイタン$$ Base - $$サーペンタイン姉妹$$' Room～

288:t_1:4.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「...The data $$ニコラス・バセロン$$ sent us is quite interesting.」

288:t_1:5.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「Yes. Sending him into $c was worthwhile.」

288:t_1:6.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「But we meant to have him study parallel-world $$バスターマシン$$s and bring back data on their $$宇宙怪獣$$...」

288:t_1:7.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「I never imagined he'd leap beyond the solar system to fight at the galactic center.」

288:t_1:8.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「It seems that thing is a parallel-world space monster, rather than an alien $$トップレス$$.」

288:t_1:9.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「His data has also given us a prospect of reviving it.」

288:t_1:10.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「All we have to do now is prepare.」

288:t_1:11.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「Once it awakens and we receive its power...」

288:t_1:14.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「Now, shall we have dinner?」

288:t_1:15.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「$$タイタン$$ crab... I'm getting tired of it.」

288:t_1:16.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「Don't worry. I'm sure we'll have other ingredients soon.」

288:t_1:17.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「By the way, where is $c now?」

288:t_1:18.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「I think they should be reaching Mars about now.」

288:t_1:20.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「Let's eat. And pray for our future.」

288:t_2:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...So you learned Prince $$ユーサー$$'s true intentions.」

288:t_2:5.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Yes. Once the $$インサラウム$$ people's settlement on Mars had settled down, Commander $$マルグリット$$ told us.」

288:t_2:6.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「When we learned we'd forced all blame for the war onto the prince, every former knight considered suicide out of guilt.」

288:t_2:7.en:
$$シン$$
「Wait! If you did that, everything $$ユーサー・インサラウム$$ did would be wasted!」

288:t_2:8.en:
$$赤木$$
「Then the prince would have died for nothing!」

288:t_2:9.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Commander $$マルグリット$$ said exactly what you've just said.」

288:t_2:10.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「So we cast aside our title and pride as knights. Even in shame, we chose to live here on Mars with the $$インサラウム$$ people.」

288:t_2:11.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We deeply apologize to you for what we did then.」

288:t_2:13.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「You have already atoned. Never forget your remorse for the past, but let us move toward the future together now.」

288:t_2:15.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「And on behalf of our people, I thank you for mourning our prince.」

288:t_2:16.en:
$$青山$$
「...By the way, isn't the settlers' leader, $$マルグリット$$, here on Mars?」

288:t_2:17.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「The commander should be on Earth now.」

288:t_2:18.en:
$$キャシー$$
「...Should be...? Haven't you heard from her?」

288:t_2:20.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「But we believe she is safe. She is the last $$ハイナイト$$, the one who kept our hope alive.」

288:t_2:21.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Then let's get to the point. Please tell us what you know of the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$'s current condition.」

288:t_2:22.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「...As we continued terraforming, we also surveyed this Mars, which was restructured by the $$新世時空震動$$.」

288:t_2:23.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「When the destruction of the $$時の牢獄$$ caused new worlds to merge, a new enemy appeared on Mars too.」

288:t_2:24.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「An organization other than $$サイデリアル$$?」

288:t_2:25.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Yes. They were a group descended from Earthlings.」

288:t_2:26.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「While $$サイデリアル$$ was invading Earth, we were fighting that enemy here.」

288:t_2:27.en:
$$勝平$$
「Whoa! You had it rough too!」

288:t_2:28.en:
$$甲児$$
「What happened to the battle with that enemy?」

288:t_2:29.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Well... Our standoff continued, but someone destroyed the enemy's headquarters, bringing the fighting to an end.」

288:t_2:31.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「The battle took place in a magnetic storm, so we don't know the details.」

288:t_2:32.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「That enemy called themselves 《$$メガノイド$$》s. Do you know anything about them?」

288:t_2:34.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I've never heard of them...」

288:t_2:35.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Around the time the $$メガノイド$$s were destroyed, someone exploited a gap in our surveillance and unsealed the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$.」

288:t_2:36.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Was it connected to whoever defeated the $$メガノイド$$s?」

288:t_2:37.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We don't know. The garrison only saw a black machine... the $$シュロウガ$$, flying away from the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$.」

288:t_2:38.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We immediately informed the Earth Federation, but...」

288:t_2:39.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「So the Federation wasn't in a position to deal with events on Mars...」

288:t_2:40.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「We had our hands full fighting $$サイデリアル$$ back home.」

288:t_2:41.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Unable to stand by, Commander $$マルグリット$$ set out for Earth herself as a messenger.」

288:t_2:42.en:
$$キラ$$
「So we passed each other along the way...」

288:t_2:43.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Then we'd like to investigate the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ ourselves.」

288:t_2:44.en:
$$ランド$$
「Right. We were the ones who shoved him into it, so we'd better provide some after-sales service.」

288:t_2:45.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...Would that be acceptable to everyone from $$インサラウム$$?」

288:t_2:46.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Understood. Please leave resupply and other arrangements to us.」

288:t_2:47.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ is also responsible for the loss of His Highness and $$インサラウム$$'s greatest treasure, the $$ジ・インサー$$.」

288:t_2:48.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We're in no position to ask this of you, but the late prince's lingering sorrow...」

288:t_2:49.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We promise to do our utmost.」

288:t_2:50.en:
$$ランド$$
($$ユーサー$$... The people you loved still love you.)

288:t_2:51.en:
$$セツコ$$
(We'll fight $$アサキム$$. For ourselves, for the people I care about, and for you and your people too...)

288:t_2:58.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I didn't expect to find someone here.」

288:t_2:60.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「...I came to confirm how it ended.」

288:t_2:61.en:
???
「For the $$メガノイド$$s... No... for the $$クロノ$$ Reformists?」

288:t_2:63.en:
???
「...$$クロノ$$ exists in many parallel worlds. Claiming to watch over humanity's evolution, they have controlled history from the shadows...」

288:t_2:64.en:
???
「But defectors emerged from within $$クロノ$$, calling themselves Reformists.」

288:t_2:66.en:
???
「One of them, $$破嵐創造$$, created a new humanity, the $$メガノイド$$s, to hasten evolution by strengthening human will... the ego.」

288:t_2:67.en:
???
「By sacrificing his own wife and son.」
